metadata.description: Alias for the Maven `package` phase so `nx run-many -t build` covers Java too.
Runs the API with devtools reload on :8080.
Exports the OpenAPI contract to packages/api/openapi.json. Runs ./mvnw directly: the @nx/maven batch executor drops -P profile args.
Regenerates the jOOQ classes in com.proj.server.db from the migrated database. Needs `pnpm db:start`. Runs ./mvnw directly for the same reason as openapi.
